company.name: InceptionLRT
company.shortDescription: InceptionLRT is a standalone liquid restaking protocol designed specifically for Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs).
company.description:
InceptionLRT was a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol that operated as a liquid restaking platform built on EigenLayer. Founded by Pedro Verdades and Jean Simone, the project launched in August 2023.

Backed by the founders’ experience in finance and Bitcoin mining, InceptionLRT was driven by the emerging opportunity of yield stacking within the restaking ecosystem. The protocol aimed to maximize capital efficiency by enabling users to restake assets while maintaining liquidity.

InceptionLRT was formed through the merger of two specialized companies—one focused on native staking and the other on liquid staking token (LST) solutions—bringing together complementary expertise to create a unified restaking platform.

productsAndServices.description: Tokens minted on InceptionLRT representing restaked liquid staking tokens, maintaining liquidity while enabling participation in multiple DeFi strategies.

productsAndServices.description: A modular staking solution that leverages EigenLayer’s shared security infrastructure to enable flexible and scalable restaking of Ethereum and various liquid staking tokens.

productsAndServices.description: A suite of integrations enabling users to deploy their Liquid Restaking Tokens across various DeFi protocols for liquidity provision, lending, and yield aggregation.
